description: This file defines a mock implementation of WebSocket for testing or injecting WebSocket behavior in a controlled environment. It includes type definitions, a WebSocketMock class extending EventTarget, and an inject function to override the global WebSocket with the mock.

classes.name: WebSocketMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of WebSocket for testing, supporting event handling, message sending, connection management, and API methods to simulate WebSocket behavior.

methods.name: inject
methods.description: Injects the WebSocketMock implementation into the global scope, replacing the native WebSocket with the mock version.

methods.name: _apiConnect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the WebSocket server, initializing the native WebSocket and setting up event handlers.

methods.name: _apiSendToServer
methods.description: Sends a message to the WebSocket server, buffering if the connection is still establishing.

methods.name: _apiCloseServer
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection to the server, with optional code and reason.

methods.name: _apiClosePage
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket from the page side, dispatching close events and cleaning up.
